text:
zoe: FYI AuroraMed CISO escalated to exec. Blockers: BYOK for keys, EU-only processing during POC, completion of their security questionnaire v2.1, and a clearly scoped SLA for nightly batch inference. They asked for pen-test summary and an ops runbook. Need owners and a quick exec deck.
harry: I can own BYOK/KMS. Short note: Dedicated supports KMS wrap; Private supports HSM. For the POC we can offer KMS key-wrap + manual rotation; full BYOK automation needs infra change. I'll draft the caveats by 11:30 PT.
maya: I'll own the SLA + perf. AuroraMed wants 80 req/s sustained for batch windows and an availability target of 99.95% during business hours. Need sample batch sizes and schema. Zoe, can you get payload samples?
zoe: Asking AuroraMed for sanitized batch files and the exact questionnaire reference. Also requesting preferred exec times.
legal: Legal here ; we can sign a pilot addendum with region-processing clause limited to the POC window. Pen-test artifacts require NDA; please route requests via legal queue with subject "AuroraMed pen-test".
se-bot: ticket created: AMED-4410 "AuroraMed POC: BYOK + EU residency + SLA" Assigned: se-oncall, infra-pilot.
harry: If they insist on key custody we can run a short-term manual rotation process and provide proof-of-rotation logs. Will add to the one-slide.
maya: For perf baseline I'll run a small synthetic tonight once I get sample payloads. If batch sizes are large, we may need an autoscale runway. Will include cost options: metered vs reserved pilot.
ops-bot: reminder: provisional exec bridge scheduled 2026-03-05T15:00:00-08:00.
zoe: I'll assemble a 1-slide ask: 1) sign pilot addendum + NDA for pen-test exchange, 2) provide sanitized payloads and contact for perf tests, 3) confirmation on BYOK acceptance of manual rotation. Will post slide by 10:30 PT.
legal: I'll pre-draft the NDA note and an addendum template. ETA midday.
harry: One more caveat: delegated-admin for SCIM not supported today; can propose scoped user/group sync or an SE-managed proxy for provisioning. I'll note alternatives.
zoe: Thanks team. Invites will go out once we confirm AuroraMed availability. Closing loop and will post attachments here. :white_check_mark:
